description: This file defines the WorkflowStateMachineDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the WorkflowStateMachine entity, providing additional methods such as retrieving roles to notify associated with workflow states.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachineDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps the WorkflowStateMachine entity and adds extra methods for handling workflow state notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a WorkflowStateMachine object.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Retrieves the roles to notify from the wrapped WorkflowStateMachine, splitting them into an array if not null.
